vision: Scalable team design: hire against metrics and operating system gaps — not founder bandwidth. Each role has a trigger, KPIs, and a 90-day outcome.

teamModel.hirePrinciple: Automate first, hire when a weekly review metric is red for 2+ weeks or queue blocks revenue.

hireSequence.trigger: ops_health yellow 2w OR founder >6h/week on incidents
CAC payback >6mo OR funnel CR down 20% QoQ
partner pipeline >50 active OR MRR growth stalls
100K MAU path OR analytics cap hits weekly
AI cost >8% gross margin OR narration adoption >15% MAU

roles.title: Growth Marketer
roles.why: Founder cannot run paid + organic loops, CRO experiment velocity, and lifecycle copy at scale. Growth review needs a dedicated owner for acquisition and funnel iteration.

when.hireTrigger: Blended CAC payback >6 months for 2 consecutive weekly KPI reviews OR paid spend >₺50K/mo without stable funnel CR.

first90Days.goal: Baseline CAC/LTV report; own growth weekly pre-read; ship 1 CRO experiment
2 live acquisition channels with weekly spend cap; lifecycle copy audit for top 3 flows
Funnel CR +10% vs baseline OR CAC payback ≤6mo; growth review runs without founder

roles.title: Product Designer
roles.why: Conversion and trust live in Planlar, checkout, and decision UX. P4 enterprise polish needs a single design owner for component system and mobile-first flows.

when.hireTrigger: Planlar/checkout redesign in roadmap now queue OR NPS/qual feedback on UX blocks 2+ RICE items.
deferIf: no design system doc in repo
frontend engineer not hired or contracted

kpis.label: CRO tests with design hypothesis won

first90Days.goal: Audit Planlar + checkout; Figma/system aligned to css/premium-pages
Ship redesigned pricing shell A/B with growth marketer; mobile pass on top 5 routes
Checkout CR lift measurable; design checklist in product review gate

roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.why: SPA, admin panel, and Auto bundle need sustained velocity. CRO and i18n block on frontend capacity; founder cannot ship experiments weekly.

when.hireTrigger: ≥3 items in roadmap now queue tagged frontend OR bundle budget failures block release.

first90Days.goal: Own router/admin patterns; fix top 3 admin-panel stability items; 1 CRO ship
Lazy-load admin chunks; i18n top-20 strings extracted; 2 experiments live
Release train without founder review; zero critical UX regressions in CI

roles.title: Backend / Platform Engineer
roles.why: Supabase, edge functions, analytics volume, and 100K MAU path need dedicated platform ownership. Founder cannot own retention purge, warehouse export, and partner dispatch queue.

when.hireTrigger: analytics_sample_cap alert 2 weeks OR scale readiness 100K confidence <70% with infra items in now queue.

first90Days.goal: Own supabase/functions + migrations; funnel_daily MV or rollup PR; on-call runbook
Warehouse export spike; pooler enabled; halve admin live analytics scans
100K scale checklist 80% complete; incident MTTD <4h without founder

roles.title: AI / Product Analyst
roles.why: Decision engine, scoring explainability, and AI unit economics need an owner who blends product and data. Prevents uncontrolled Groq spend and improves narration quality.

when.hireTrigger: AI proxy rate-limit ops events up 2 weeks OR narration used by >10% MAU with flat conversion.
deferIf: P17 unit economics not in weekly KPI review

first90Days.goal: Dashboard for AI cost/user; map narration budget to Pro tiers; baseline feedback
Ship quota table or feature flag; A/B deterministic-only vs narration
AI gross margin within target; product review owns AI roadmap slice

roles.title: B2B Sales Lead
roles.why: Partner and Pro B2B motion needs pipeline discipline beyond automation. CRM auto_leads and partner applications require human close for high-LTV deals.

when.hireTrigger: >30 qualified partner or fleet leads/month OR sales review shows pipeline coverage <2× quota.

first90Days.goal: CRM hygiene; daily sales review agenda; first 10 qualified conversations
Partner offer playbook; co-own dispatch SLA with partner success
Quota model live; ≥3 won deals; sales review runs without founder on calls

roles.title: Partner Success Manager
roles.why: Dispatch SLA, endpoint health, and partner onboarding are operational revenue levers. Automation handles retry; partners need a human owner for activation and churn.

when.hireTrigger: >=5 active partner endpoints OR dispatch success <85% for 2 weeks.

first90Days.goal: Own partner health dashboard; top 5 partner QBRs; reduce dead dispatches 50%
Onboarding checklist <7d; circuit-breaker playbooks per tier
Dispatch ≥90%; settlement gaps doc → decision log; partner review without founder

roles.title: Ops Manager
roles.why: Company OS and P9 automation need a human COO-delegate for incidents, cron health, and weekly KPI facilitation — so founder exits daily firefighting.

when.hireTrigger: First hire recommended: ops_health not green 2 weeks OR founder incident time >6h/week.

first90Days.goal: Run daily ops + weekly KPI; document on-call; zero missed CEO alert digests
Incident postmortem process live; all crons monitored; independence score ≥80%
Founder <2h/week on ops; hire roadmap RICE inputs for next role

rules: Every hire linked to a decision record DR-* before offer
90-day plan in decision-log or onboarding doc before day 1
Founder only interim owner until ops_manager + one function lead hired
